title: [Synthetic] E_ABORT bypasses my GameRuntimeException catch
body: This is an invented diagnostic scenario, not a reproduction. I am reading source at 8ae3563d2fcd9ecffd45ec15c436bacf3ee44033 for net10.0/win-x64, GDK edition 260404. My title catches GameRuntimeException around an awaited operation. If native completion returns E_ABORT, should the task fault with that exception, or use .NET cancellation? Please identify the result-reading path and the HRESULT mapping; I have not run a live packaged test.

comments.body: I only need static analysis. No stack trace or observed native result exists for this invented example.
